570  Part 4 Nutrition Therapy
Several other nutritional deﬁ ciencies or toxicities have been 
implicated in RBC disorders, such as vitamins A, E, and K, 
pyridoxine, zinc, copper, manganese, fatty acids, and protein. 
Severe vitamin C, niacin, riboﬂ avin, and thiamin deﬁ ciencies 
are also associated with abnormal erythropoiesis.42–44 Th e nor-
mal development of hematological cells is dependent on dietary
